regime.summary: SBP hiked 100bp on 2026-04-27 with CPI at 10.91% and rising, Brent up 46.9% in three months, and the 6M bill only 0.48pp above the policy rate. The nearest analogue in the pack is the 2021-22 tightening with external stress, where the method says hold bills and set a return trigger. Reserves and current account are not in the pack. Index is down 8.9% over 3 months. Stay mostly in cash.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 11.5%; last MPC decision 2026-04-27: hike (+100bp)
CPI YoY 10.91% for 2026-04 (published by 2026-05-03); three months earlier (2026-01) 5.79%
Regime: 6M T-bill minus policy rate +0.48pp (market near policy rate); CPI rising over 3 months (+5.1pp)
Tightening plus external stress: rate up 800bp in ten months with CPI above it.
Lesson: hold bills, and set a trigger to return.
